context_requirements: Expression of SRD5A1 and/or SRD5A2 to engage the canonical target
Androgen receptor (AR) expression and functional AR signaling for the main downstream effects
Prostate lineage or AR-positive context; non-prostate lines lack the relevant axis
Prolonged exposure (24 h or more) for transcriptional consequences
falsifiers: No change in SRD5A2 or glucocorticoid-responsive genes (e.g., TSC22D3, DUSP1) at 6 h in any line
No reduction in AR target genes (e.g., KLK3, TMPRSS2) at 24 h in VCAP or other AR-positive lines
No cell-cycle gene downregulation at 24 h in any line
Strong, rapid transcriptional responses in AR-negative, SRD5A-low lines such as A375 or A549
Absence of any dose-dependent or time-dependent pattern across the nine lines

evidence.supports: Finasteride causes prostate atrophy and apoptosis in vivo, indicating 5ARI can reduce prostate cell survival
Dutasteride reduces viability/proliferation and alters cell cycle, metabolic, and apoptotic gene expression in androgen-responsive LNCaP prostate cancer cells
Dutasteride induces apoptosis in androgen-sensitive prostate cell lines but not in androgen-independent PC-3
Dutasteride alters gene expression in androgen-responsive prostate cancer xenografts
5ARI treatment lowers DHT and AR target genes while raising glucocorticoid levels in human prostate tissue
